nodes.speaker: The Empty Table
nodes.text: ...It was set for six. It was always set for six.
[i]The shapes at the table are not guests anyone could name. They are the outlines of people who were loud, and hungry, and late. They are warm now.[/i]

nodes.speaker: The Empty Table
nodes.text: I thought if no one came, it meant no one had ever needed me.
[i]You hold the lantern up to the long table. It is only a table. A table is just a place where people are invited.[/i]
